dlg.rav.first.0.note: Half-drunk music. 'Well, well.' amused. The parrot joke dry. Three names, each funnier; 'McBreathless' with relish.

dlg.rav.first.1.note: Dry amusement; 'Sit, before Holloway sees you.' low and quick.

dlg.rav.first.2.note: Grumbling 'You're in my light.' Pause. Gives up: 'Oh, sit, then.' Self-mocking résumé. 'Ask me which paid better.' a wink.

dlg.rav.hub.1.note: Dry jokes; 'I checked.' deadpan. The Sella line bawdy and fond.

dlg.rav.kerchiefs.0.note: A man describing family without saying so. Practical advice with gallows humour at the end.

dlg.rav.clerk.0.note: Pub gossip, then 'Between us' lower. Fond scorn: 'like a boy with a frog'. A pause; uneasy: 'Not seen him since.'

dlg.rav.clerk.1.note: Pub gossip. 'Draw your own lines, pal.' A pause; slow realisation on 'now I think of it.'

dlg.rav.fence.0.note: 'Oh, dear.' amused. Business. The last sentence a grim little truth.

dlg.rav.roost.0.note: Instructions with relish. The password quoted with a grin. 'I was never here.' deadpan.

dlg.rav.redcowl.0.note: A pub story about the leg, laughing at himself. A pause; the door shuts: 'Don't ask me the rest.' gentle but final.

dlg.rav.cb_tricked_redcowl.0.note: 'RAN' stressed with joy. Laughing. Buying the round.

dlg.rav.cb_killed_redcowl.0.note: Narrator: he doesn't look up. 'You killed him.' flat. Pause. 'Dunstan.' the one time he says it; barely there. Mother's idea, a wet laugh. Narrator: he drinks. Then defending his brother. 'I'll be a doctor again tomorrow.' trying to be wry, failing.

dlg.rav.cb_burned_roost.0.note: Reporting. Pause. Convincing himself: 'He'll have got out. He always gets out.' Then bitter and quiet: 'The ones in the cages didn't.'

dlg.rav.say_calling.0.note: A doctor's eye; dry advice about Holloway.

dlg.rav.say_calling.3.note: Suddenly sober and interested: 'Who taught you?'

dlg.rav.say_calling.4.note: Suddenly sober and interested: 'Who taught you?'

dlg.rav.t_rav.0.note: A list growing worse; the teeth man grotesque and funny. 'and I have a fifth.' resigned.

dlg.rav.pain.0.note: Mock propriety. 'Largely professionally.' a twinkle. The anaesthetic joke dry.
